newsitem.title: USA: CPC International Q1 net shr $0.73 vs $0.82.
newsitem.headline: CPC International Q1 net shr $0.73 vs $0.82.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
Full name of company is CPC International Inc.

NOTE: Income from continuing operations rose 9.1 percent to $117.5 million from $107.7 million last year. During the quarter, the company announced that it intends to spin off its corn refining operations in order to benefit sales and profits of both its packaged food operations and the corn refining business. The discontinued (corn refining) operations showed a loss of $.06 per share for the quarter, compared to profits of $.10 per share for the same period last year.
